segments.name: Cruise
segments.description: Operates cruise brands serving seasoned travelers and premium families with worldwide itineraries, onboard dining, entertainment, accommodations and shore excursions.
segments.evidence: We have concluded that our business has a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay cruise fares, and onboard purchases such as casino, food and beverages, retail, spa and shore excursions add revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: During the voyage, we generate onboard and other revenue for additional products and services which are not included in the cruise fare
